title: Conditional R-078: give spin feedback direct stroke authority
hypothesis: Applying spin-error feedback directly to the periodic stroke raises slow-spin success without restoring the harmful capture compression.

prediction.against: R-078 constant-stroke-gain control on the qualified exact zero-curl parent
prediction.rationale: Beating an equally evaluated constant-gain control distinguishes useful feedback from merely strengthening the open-loop stroke. This conditionally re-triages R-078 because the first proposal supplies a prospective qualification path; its earlier deferral measured no repair outcome.

protocol.command: gpu run 'bash -lc "source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --study r081_stroke_feedback --log-dir logs/pen_spin/r081_stroke_feedback"'
code_changes: New study module lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/stroke_feedback.py registered as --study r081_stroke_feedback in scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py; settings in the research_protocols block of config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml. Preflight: logs/pen_spin/r080_zero_curl_qualification_90/qualification.json must say qualifies and repair_parent_eligible, else the study exits before any episode. The parent is the qualified exact zero-curl clamp (the R-065 curl_clamp substitution of config/pen_spin/r046_block3_incumbent, hashes checked).

Feedback: one audited substitution on the clamp's source, + rolling * gait becomes + self._stroke_gain(spin) * rolling * gait, with gain = clip(4 / max(|spin|, 1), 0.5, 2), spin the policy's own axial rate (5 * obj_angvel projected on the pen axis, rad/s) from the current observation, per environment per step. Constant control: the arithmetic mean of that gain over all recorded in-play steps of the clamp's archived R-068 fresh and promotion runs, frozen with provenance before any episode. Identity form returns exactly 1.0, gated bit for bit offline on D-050's archived observations. Compression stays zero; every other term unchanged.

One frozen 120-case Stage-3 manifest on seed 4663 at config/manifests/pen_spin_stage3_r081_block_s4663.yaml (cases 0-9 unused, promotion 10-39, fresh 40-119), placement-disjoint from every committed pen-spin manifest. Arms zero_curl, stroke_feedback, constant_gain, each on each panel in its own fresh process: six processes, 330 episodes, zero LLM calls.

Primary: stroke_feedback minus constant_gain fresh sustained success (80 pairs), 95% t interval; at least +0.05; supported if the mean is at least +0.05 and the lower bound is above zero; refuted if the upper bound is below +0.05; otherwise inconclusive. Adoption: strict promotion against the qualified parent on cases 10-39, fresh lower bound above zero against it, no more observed drops on either panel; no retry or panel enlargement. Reported per arm and panel: sustained success, paired success and drop differences with intervals and win/loss/tie, failure split, in-play mean |spin|, gain activity (fraction of in-play steps with gain outside [0.9, 1.1] and the mean gain), drive and per-axis executed-action saturation. If feedback activates without a success gain, R-043 takes priority. Held-out split untouched.

falsified_by: The fresh paired interval's upper bound against the constant-gain control is below +0.05. An interval including zero does not establish feedback benefit; failure to beat the qualified parent under strict promotion, or more observed drops, blocks adoption.

If tuning improves success without more drops, use the winner for repair. If feedback activates without improving success, prioritize R-043. Defer cold search and R-055. advisor.reasoning: The constant-gain control distinguishes useful online regulation from simply strengthening the stroke, a mechanism R-078's deferral did not test. If feedback activates without improving success, prioritize R-043 rather than continuing automatically to another stroke repair.
